House
rules
for
this
lesson
The stopwatch and a paper tally are the record. The student writes their own numbers.
No band is spoken or written. Record only with written permission.
Questions, word lists and listening scripts are read aloud, never projected. Keys and models are shown only
after the student has tried.
Praise by quoting the student’s exact sentence. One ﬁx at a time.
Avoid cards, prompts and scripts this student has already practised; swap in fresh ones of the same type.

notes
Say: “Last lesson was about widening. Today we ﬁnd out how far your story really goes.”
Set-up: stopwatch and a paper tally are the record. No band is spoken or written in this lesson. Record only
with written permission.
Reveals: model answers and keys are read from these notes or shown only after the student has tried. Part 1
and Part 3 questions, word lists and listening scripts are read aloud, never projected.
Stance: direct, fast, fair. Praise only by quoting the student’s exact sentence. Never “good job” without the
sentence.

Say: “Today the ﬂoor is 90 and the target is 110. I will not stop you early and I will not help.”
If the student writes “?”: “That is information. We measure properly today.”
Write down the target the student states. Floor 90 s · target 110 s · stretch 120 s.

ﬁrst. 1 I say a word. 2 You say the past. 3 Hold the last sound. 10 words.
Teacher
notes
Say the base word every 10 seconds (5-second get-ready ﬁrst); never repeat a word. The student says the past
form.
Words (base →  past, ending sound): 1 hurry →  hurried /d/ · 2 decide →  decided /ɪd/ · 3 stop →  stopped /t/ · 4
carry →  carried /d/ · 5 start →  started /ɪd/ · 6 ask →  asked /t/ · 7 want →  wanted /ɪd/ · 8 close →  closed /d/ · 9
jump →  jumped /t/ · 10 miss →  missed /t/
Tally: an ending counts only if the last sound is clearly heard. Write each missed word; they become the re-test
list on step 08.
Likely
failures: cluster endings (asked, jumped, missed, stopped): ﬁnal-consonant dropping carried over from
the ﬁrst language.
Measure: Endings heard /10, cold. Target 8/10 or more.

Teacher
notes
Say: “Go.” No frames shown. If the student stalls, wait 5 seconds, then say only “Thank you.”
Tally (tick only if unprompted): BEFORE (a past habit) · AFTER (what changed) · COMPARE (a comparison with
before) · seconds spoken.
Do not show or say the frames “Before that / After that” here; they appear on step 09 only.
The bridge holds if all three are heard. Any missing, or under 25 s →  run the bridge half of step 09 in full.
Measure: Before / after / compare, unprompted.

Teacher
notes
Say: “Go.” (5-second get-ready, then 45 seconds.)
Drift
tally: a present verb in the story part counts as a drift. “Now…” sentences and words inside a direct quote
are not drifts.
Write each drifted verb as said (visit →  visited; we are →  we were). These are the repair list for step 09.
Measure: Present-tense drifts in 45 s. Target 2 or fewer.
